why: The person writes a secretary's duties by their own press. The secretary the record names may write them with its own key and a warrant quoting the person's words from a decision the duties rest on. The grant alone, a signed package item and every other agent are refused. The second check is in checkTheDutiesTakenAway (wave 13s round 97): duties whose data names no secretary are taken away, by a delete or a change out of the kind, only by the person's own press, or inside a test world by those who hold the person's authority there, because there is no secretary to carry the words. Neither words nor a raise open that one.
